summary: Frontend verification of Master Admin IMPERSONATION chevrons + MODULE SELECTORS for Service Desk & Inventory & Distribution. All 6 requested scenarios PASS via Playwright on the live preview URL. No frontend bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminOrganizations.js is ~2300+ lines; the org-list card, edit-user drawer, create-org dialog, feature panel wrapper, and the inline InventoryRow/ServiceDeskRow could be extracted into their own files for maintainability.

Cookie consent banner at page bottom initially intercepted clicks on the Edit-User drawer's Inventory toggle (which sits low in the drawer scroll). Not a bug — but consider raising the toggle above the fold or auto-dismissing the banner for admin console pages.

PrimaryContactPasswordReveal and other components inside AdminOrganizations.js redeclare `const API = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL` locally; the module-scope constant on line 34 is already `API = ${...}/api`. Multiple shadow definitions are a foot-gun already flagged in a prior comment in the file. Consolidate.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 review points verified end-to-end: (1) chevron org-picker buttons portal-switch-org-picker-btn, portal-switch-service-desk-org-picker-btn, portal-switch-inventory-org-picker-btn all present. (2) Service Desk chevron opens org-portal-modal titled 'Open a client's Service Desk'; picking iso-demo-org calls POST /api/master-admin/org-portal-login/iso-demo-org?area=service_desk and lands on /service-desk with the desk shell rendered + red impersonation banner ('You are viewing as owner@isodemo.com. Every action is logged.'). (3) Inventory chevron opens org-portal-modal titled 'Open a client's Inventory'; picking iso-demo-org calls area=inventory and lands on /inventory with data-testid inventory-distribution-page rendered + impersonation banner. (4) Edit User drawer for manager@isodemo.com (iso-manager) shows BOTH edit-user-info-row-service-desk (with edit-user-service-desk-toggle) and edit-user-info-row-inventory (with edit-user-inventory-toggle). Clicking Grant fired POST /master-admin/inventory-access/grant → 200 and flipped to 'Revoke'; clicking again fired /revoke → 200 and flipped back to 'Grant'. (5) Create Organisation dialog module picker shows all 6 modules — org-form-modules-{operations,crm,memberships,marketing,service_desk,inventory} (note: testid prefix is 'org-form-modules-*' inside Create dialog, and 'org-modules-*' inside the Edit Details tab — both work but the review-request example referenced only the generic prefix). (6) No regression suspected — code inspection confirms can(user,'view_inventory') = is_inventory||is_service_desk||is_master_admin so owner@isodemo.com (service_desk=true) retains /inventory access.
